data.title: Passport application appointment on 12 May 2026
data.summary: The Stadt Musterstadt Bürgeramt confirms your appointment to apply for a passport on 12 May 2026 at 9:30 am, Bürgeramt Mitte, counter 4. The fee is €70.00.
data.explanation: This confirms your appointment at the citizens' office (Bürgeramt) to apply for a passport. Bring your current ID, a recent biometric passport photo and the €70.00 fee (card payment is possible). If you can't attend, cancel the appointment online.
